{
  "dataset_name": "volcanoes_c1",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "v1_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized V1 using training mean and std for linear margin scaling.",
      "value_range": [-2.0, 2.0],
      "feature_family": "normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides smooth standardized input aiding linear SVM margin geometry.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(V1 - 509.9693723069757) / 280.3206803251786"
    },
    {
      "name": "v2_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized V2 using training mean and std.",
      "value_range": [-2.0, 2.0],
      "feature_family": "normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth standardized projection for linear separator.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(V2 - 510.44392686619307) / 288.5767599415063"
    },
    {
      "name": "v3_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized V3 using training mean and std.",
      "value_range": [-3.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Equalizes scale of V3 with V1 and V2 for hyperplane fitting.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(V3 - 0.41113052486316526) / 0.06076998440149803"
    },
    {
      "name": "v1_v2_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of V1 to V2 capturing relative balance, clipped to a stable range.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures relational structure linearly that raw features cannot.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(V1 / (V2 + 1.0), 0.0, 5.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v1_v2_abs_diff_norm",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute difference between V1 and V2 normalized by their sum.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Symmetric measure of disparity useful as a linear feature.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(V1 - V2) / (V1 + V2 + 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v1_v2_mean_log",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed average of V1 and V2 to compress high-magnitude tails.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 8.0],
      "feature_family": "composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth monotonic composite supporting linear weighting.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p((V1 + V2) / 2.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v3_deviation",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute deviation of V3 from its training mean, a continuous severity score.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 0.5],
      "feature_family": "severity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Highlights atypical V3 values which may carry margin signal.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(V3 - 0.41113052486316526)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v3_squared_dev",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Squared deviation of V3 from its mean, emphasizing extreme values.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 0.25],
      "feature_family": "severity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides quadratic-style signal that remains linear in input space.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(V3 - 0.41113052486316526) ** 2"
    },
    {
      "name": "v1_v2_product_scaled",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Scaled product of V1 and V2 to encode joint magnitude.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures interaction between V1 and V2 with bounded scale for SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((V1 * V2) / (1008.0 * 1008.0), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v3_weighted_v1v2",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "V3 weighted by normalized average of V1 and V2, a composite intensity.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 0.8],
      "feature_family": "composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Combines all three inputs into a single smooth weighted projection.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V3 * ((V1 + V2) / 2016.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "row_extremity_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic estimate of how extreme the row's combined V1, V2, V3 values are relative to typical training distribution, derived from standardized magnitudes.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "judgment_severity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a smooth holistic outlierness measure that can shift linear margins.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(((V1 - 509.97) / 280.32) ** 2 + ((V2 - 510.44) / 288.58) ** 2 + ((V3 - 0.4111) / 0.0608) ** 2) / np.sqrt(3.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "spatial_symmetry_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of spatial symmetry between V1 and V2 modulated by V3, judging whether the row reflects a balanced configuration.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "judgment_structure",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Bounded symmetry score that helps the linear separator capture geometric balance.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "1.0 - np.clip(np.abs(V1 - V2) / (V1 + V2 + 1.0) + np.abs(V3 - 0.4111), 0.0, 1.0)"
    }
  ]
}
